name: bigdata
title: 大数据平台 PHP 客户端
tagline: 十九个平台，一套 PHP API
description: 把 Trino、Hadoop、Hive、Spark、Flink、Doris、StarRocks 等 19 个大数据平台的客户端收进一个 Composer 包，21 个驱动键按需启用，可选依赖只在真正使用时检查。

pet.name: 多多
pet.title: 数据章鱼多多
pet.desc: 一只青色卡通小章鱼，戴 PHP 紫围巾，八条彩色触手连接 SQL、Hadoop、湖仓、调度和 NoSQL，头顶挂着 19 的平台徽章。它会呼吸浮动、眨眼，并随表情摆动触手。
pet.quote: 八条触手，连接十九个平台。

hero.sub: 19 个平台、21 个驱动键，可选依赖按需加载，六个框架共用一套 API。

about.heading: 一个包，十九个平台
body: bigdata-php 用同一套 PHP API 连接 SQL 与 OLAP 引擎、Hadoop 生态、调度系统、湖仓元数据目录和 NoSQL 存储。
HTTP 驱动开箱即用；Hive 与 Cassandra 的可选依赖在创建驱动时检查，Doris/StarRocks 的 pdo_mysql 只在执行 SQL 时检查，不拖累基础安装。

features.heading: 一个入口，覆盖五类平台
features.sub: 驱动按需创建、按名缓存，不引入统一 SQL 层。

items.title: 统一驱动管理
items.body: BigData::driver 按名称创建并缓存实例，未知驱动键直接拦截。

items.title: 可选依赖
items.body: thrift、php-cassandra 在创建驱动时检查，pdo_mysql 在执行 SQL 时检查。

items.title: SQL 与 OLAP

items.title: Hadoop 与湖仓

items.title: 调度与 NoSQL
items.body: Airflow、DolphinScheduler、Oozie、HBase、Cassandra。

items.title: 六框架适配
items.body: Laravel、ThinkPHP、Webman、Hyperf、Yii2、Yii3 六个适配器。

en.tagline: One PHP API for big data
en.description: A Composer package for 19 big data platforms: SQL and OLAP, Hadoop, lakehouse metadata, schedulers, and NoSQL, with optional dependencies.

hero.sub: 19 platforms, 21 driver keys, optional dependencies, and one API across six frameworks.

about.heading: One package, nineteen platforms
body: bigdata-php connects to SQL and OLAP engines, the Hadoop ecosystem, schedulers, lakehouse metadata catalogs, and NoSQL stores through one PHP API.
HTTP drivers work out of the box; Hive and Cassandra dependencies are checked when the driver is created, while Doris/StarRocks pdo_mysql is checked only when SQL runs.

features.heading: One entry point, many drivers
features.sub: Drivers are created on demand and cached by name, with no unified SQL layer.

items.title: Unified driver management
items.body: BigData::driver creates and caches instances by name; unknown keys are rejected.

items.title: Optional dependencies
items.body: thrift and php-cassandra are checked when the driver is created; pdo_mysql is checked when SQL runs.

items.title: SQL and OLAP
items.body: Trino, Doris, StarRocks, Kylin, and Druid share one result convention.

items.title: Hadoop and lakehouse
items.body: WebHDFS, YARN, Hive, Spark, Flink, plus read-only lakehouse metadata.

items.title: Scheduling and NoSQL
items.body: Airflow, DolphinScheduler, Oozie, HBase, and Cassandra.

items.title: Six framework adapters
items.body: Laravel, ThinkPHP, Webman, Hyperf, Yii2, and Yii3.

iterations.heading: How the package grew
iterations.sub: Four releases that added drivers, frameworks, tests, and quality gates.

items.title: Unify 19 platforms
items.body: The first Composer package ships 19 platforms as 21 driver keys.

items.title: PHP 8 and six adapters
items.body: PHP 8.1 syntax is removed, six framework adapters and four diagrams land.

items.title: Integration tests and drivers
items.body: Integration tests, Cassandra paging and writes, Hudi 1.0, and framework smoke tests.

items.title: Shared support layer and lakehouse upgrades
items.body: Shared HTTP/exceptions, Hudi/Paimon S3, DeltaLog, Hive TLS, automatic framework config publishing, and quality gates.

versions.heading: Changelog
versions.sub: Recent releases; the full list is on GitHub Releases.

items.summary: All six frameworks auto-register; standalone docs and 19 driver pages, refreshed install docs, diagrams and social previews.
Looping animations for Duoduo and its 12 expressions; CI bumps actions/checkout to v7.
Config auto-publishing now uses an atomic temp-file rename so concurrent workers never read a partial file.
Framework config templates publish on first boot; fix Hive SASL login and Laravel smoke dependencies; Dependabot updates GitHub Actions only.
site/ is excluded from the repository, tags, and release archives.
Shared HTTP/exception layer, Hudi/Paimon S3, DeltaLog, Hive TLS, PHPStan, and framework smoke tests.
